rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to refer to someone who plays or mixes recorded music.

example.english: Ming is the disc jockey at the bar, and he keeps the customers dancing all night.
example.traditional: 阿明喺酒吧打碟嘅，成晚都搞到啲客跳舞跳個不停。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hai2 zau2 baa1 daa2 dip2 ge3 sing4 maan5 dou1 gaau2 dou3 di1 haak3 tiu3 mou5 tiu3 go3 bat1 ting4

rows.note: Use this more formal term in writing or when introducing the occupation explicitly.

example.english: A disc jockey is a professional responsible for choosing songs and mixing music.
example.traditional: 唱片騎師係負責揀歌同混音嘅專業人士。
example.jyutping: coeng3 pin2 ke4 si1 hai6 fu6 zaak3 gaan2 go1 tung4 wan6 jam1 ge3 zyun1 jip6 jan4 si6
